# CategoryTag

A small neutral tag for what kind of thing something is: genre, pillar, rotation, remix type or graph edge type.

`SongNodes.CategoryTag` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.CategoryTag>…</SongNodes.CategoryTag>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.CategoryTag">…</x-import>
```

## Props (CategoryTagProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Tag text: genre, pillar, rotation, remix type or edge type. |
| `emphasis` | `"default" \| "high" \| "vault"` | Emphasis: "high" for High rotation (brand-soft), "vault" for muted, default neutral. |
| `icon` | `string` | Optional Lucide icon name (edge types). |
